mechanism.claim: When six liquid alt perpetuals convert an unusually large share of their total absolute completed returns into one common cross-sectional displacement, crypto risk is repricing coherently rather than through isolated winners and losers. During elevated BTC variation, propagate the direction of the aggregate alt displacement into BTC for eight elapsed hours at a fresh upper-tail coherence state.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the sum of six completed alt returns; BTC return direction is never an input
mechanism.why_distinct: Cross-alt breadth counts signs and discards magnitudes; return dispersion measures spread and discards aggregate direction; tail asymmetry uses median-centered cubes; market-mode candidates estimate time-series return correlations; variation compression compares per-symbol path energy. HVCADCR uses the scale-free L1 directional efficiency of the current six-return cross-section, no fitted outcome, prior event set, control, volume, flow, OI, funding or premium.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: BTC completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35% while alt directional coherence enters its upper 15%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily cross-sectional directional-efficiency onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D) for each of six alts and BTC
features.alt_return: log(last completed close/first completed open), independently finite and strict nonzero
features.aggregate_alt_return: sum of six alt returns, finite strict nonzero
features.gross_cross_sectional_displacement: sum of absolute six alt returns, finite strict positive
features.coherence_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier jointly source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.85
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute open-to-close log returns over [D-24h,D)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid boundary ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent scale-free directional efficiency of the current alt return cross-section

stopping_rule: terminal first-failure sequence: source support, Gross9 novelty, train/test/eval/final strict economics, then RV20 q90 audit; no universe, block, functional, history, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
